questions.text: What is the tag for the uterus line in the female report?
questions.reason: REQ-269 acceptance requires the female uterus line to have a tag, but neither the requirement nor the source documents state one.
questions.answer:
Use UT for the uterus line in female reports.

Reason: It is short and clearly represents Uterus.

questions.text: Should O together with ROP or LOP be allowed?
questions.reason: Decides whether the tag engine accepts combined ovary tags or rejects them, which changes the validation rules and tests.
